feature: Multi-turn hypothesis investigation with targeted turn-2 context injection on D3=0 hard commits
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Experiment runs on exactly the 3 D3=0 hard commits: 2213f71944ae, 409664582f53, 572f3cee35fe — no additional commits, no omissions

AC-2: Turn-2 user message injects structured context per EC-2: (a) full content of each truncated_files[] entry when non-empty, OR (b) git blame snippets for touched production lines when truncated_files[] is empty. Message MUST include section headers '## Truncated Files' and/or '## Git Blame'. MUST NOT contain generic follow-up strings 'Continue the investigation', 'think harder', 'Focus on areas of uncertainty', or equivalent

AC-3: ΔD3 = mean(D3_2turn) − mean(D3_1turn_control) ≥ 0.25 where D3_1turn_control is frozen from EC-4 (do NOT re-run single-turn). mean(D3_1turn_control)=0.0; therefore mean(D3_2turn) ≥ 0.25. Additionally ≥2/3 commits must have D3_2turn > D3_1turn_control (anti single-commit noise)

AC-4: Cost/commit documented in report. Per-commit cost = report.metadata.total_cost_usd. Baseline = iter-3-n20-v2 mean ($0.1043/20 = $0.00522/commit). Cap = 2× baseline = $0.01044/commit. Each 2-turn commit cost_usd ≤ $0.01044

AC-5: Decision recorded in .harness/evals/exp-multiturn-ab.json with fields: decision (multi-turn-activated | single-turn-maintained), delta_d3, per_commit[{commit_id, d3_1turn, d3_2turn, cost_usd}], run_dir, judge_model

AC-6: max_turns remains 1 in run_eval.py and investigate.py CLI default until decision=multi-turn-activated in AC-5 report. Experiment uses dedicated entry (script or --max-turns 2 flag) that does NOT change run_eval.py default
AC-7: Experiment report + 3 investigation JSONs archived under output/runs/<timestamp>_multiturn_ab/ with turn_count=2 and per_stage cost breakdown in each report metadata
edge_cases: EC-1: Turn-2 context must not inject rubric, risk tier labels, discrimination signals, JIRA text, fix-commit diff, or apachejit bug labels — same hygiene as iter-3e prompt plus oracle isolation

EC-2: If truncation_metadata.truncated_files is non-empty → inject full file content for each truncated file (smart-diff path). If truncated_files is empty → inject git blame snippets for lines touched in the commit diff (blame-only path). Both paths may apply when truncation exists (files + blame for included hunks)
EC-3: D3 scoring for 2-turn path uses same judge (claude-sonnet-4-6) and same oracle path (jira | fix-diff-fallback per FIX-JUDGE-INFRA) as iter-3-n20-v2 run output/runs/2026-06-11_02-04-45_real_n20
EC-4: Frozen single-turn control scores (from eval-iter-3-n20-v2.json, do NOT re-run): 2213f71944ae D3=0.0, 409664582f53 D3=0.0, 572f3cee35fe D3=0.0
EC-5: Experiment uses max_turns=2 exactly (not 3). Turn 2 executes only after turn-1 HypothesisResponse is parsed; D3 is scored on the final turn-2 HypothesisResponse, not turn-1 alone
EC-6: Turn-2 injection content persisted in checkpoint JSON (checkpoint_dir) or report.metadata for evaluator audit — grep-able evidence that blame/truncated file content was actually sent
verification_method: 1) Run experiment on 3 commits via dedicated script/flag with max_turns=2. 2) Grep turn-2 message in checkpoints: assert '## Git Blame' or '## Truncated Files' present; assert forbidden generic strings absent. 3) Grep turn-2 for oracle leaks: no JIRA keys, 'bug introducing', fix-commit hashes. 4) Score D3_2turn via eval_judge.py (same model/oracle as iter-3-n20-v2). 5) Compute ΔD3 vs EC-4 frozen controls; check ≥2/3 per-commit improvement. 6) Verify each report metadata.total_cost_usd ≤ $0.01044. 7) Verify run_eval.py and investigate.py default max_turns=1 (grep). 8) Confirm .harness/evals/exp-multiturn-ab.json decision + output/runs/*_multiturn_ab/ artifacts exist.
